DA2.issue: Counterfactual restore and oracle success is tautological; ordinary candidate gains do not prove a new objective will win.
DA2.resolution: No GT deployment or automatic training; primary priority is conditional design guidance, not unique cause.

DA3.issue: A weak conclusion could cherry-pick7losses or treat zero duplicate bound as observability proof.
DA3.resolution: All128, 15cases, multi-support positives, quantization reversals, all NN scopes, identity fallback and no-hard-conflict caveat retained.
